bug_info.bug_desc: The WFI exit condition uses the raw pending interrupt bits (mip_q) without masking them against the enabled interrupt bits (mie_q). This causes the hart to resume from WFI when any interrupt is pending, even if the corresponding individual interrupt enable is not set, violating the RISC-V privileged specification recommendation and causing unnecessary wake-ups.
bug_info.fix_hint: Modify the WFI exit condition in the wfi_ctrl block to check for pending AND enabled interrupts (mip_q & mie_q) instead of just pending interrupts (mip_q). The fix should be applied in core/csr_regfile.sv.
